compare.description: Compare 2-4 captured sites across palette, typefaces, macrostructure, mode, style tags, type/spacing/radius scales and container width. Returns per-site breakdowns plus what they share - triangulates a house style from a few references. Each site's `provenance` says where its values come from; an empty or null value was not measured.

slugs.description: 2-4 screen slugs to compare, e.g. ['linear-app','stripe-com','vercel-com']. Discover slugs with search_screens / find_similar.

find_by_color.description: Real sites whose extracted palette sits near a hex colour (OKLAB distance, so 'close' means the same colour family, not just the same hue). Each hit's `match` names the closest palette colour and its provenance (vision = an AI estimate, with confidence). Use when a brief names a brand colour.

hex.description: Target colour as a hex string ('#c7402f', 'c7402f', '#fff'). Case-insensitive. 3- or 6-digit.

tolerance.description: Max OKLAB distance to count as a match. Defaults to 0.15 ('same family'). 0.05 ≈ 'near-identical', 0.30 ≈ 'in the same hue zip code'.

detail.description: 'standard' (default): northstar, palette, fonts, axes, macro and tags per row, plus the fold-by-fold autopsy on the top 3. 'full': the autopsy on every row (~300 tokens each; only if you will read them all). 'concise': northstar, palette, fonts. Text profile defaults to concise.

maxTokens.description: Approximate token ceiling for this response. Trims lower-ranked results and thumbnails; the top result and all URLs survive.

find_components.description: Regions the owner marked on references as one UI component (hero, pricing, features, cta, nav, footer, testimonial, logo-cloud, faq, stat): the cropped image, the owner's note on it and the parent reference (`slug`, for get_screen). Without a marked region of the type, whole references whose analysis tags the component. For copy-pasteable code use get_reference_jsx.

pageType.description: Only components from this page kind (e.g. 'pricing')

device.description: 'mobile' restricts to sites with a 375px capture pair or a mobile app screen and inlines the mobile thumbnail. Default: desktop.

maxTokens.description: Approximate token ceiling for this response. Trims lower-ranked results and thumbnails; the top result and all URLs survive.

find_reference_components.description: The owner's code templates as an index: id, label, macrostructure and a note per hero / pricing / cta / nav / footer template. None are maintained yet; the call says so. Pick one, then get_reference_jsx(type, id) for its source.

type.description: Component category (hero, pricing, cta, …). Omit to scan all types.

macro.description: Substring match on the component's macro field - e.g. 'Marquee' matches 'Marquee Hero'.

find_similar.description: A screen's nearest design neighbours - ranked by design-similarity embeddings where available, else by macrostructure / industry / style overlap. One result per site.

sameSite.description: Include other pages of the same site (default false: neighbours are other sites).

generate_color_scheme.description: Designs a Color Scheme from start colours: 11 shadcn roles (hex, oklch(), derivation, WCAG 2 contrast to their counterpart), an 11-step scale (50-950) per colour plus `danger`, contrast warnings, a ready CSS block (:root, a .dark block with the dark roles under the same names, and Tailwind v4 @theme inline), the seed used and a `generatorUrl` that opens the scheme in the owner's generator, where they adjust and save it. A brand or neutral you leave out is rolled from the measured palettes of the owner's approved references (`references`, else `project`, else all of them); each such colour names its reference. When the pool has no fitting colour, it is rolled freely; those colours, harmony hues for extras and colours moved by a hue lock carry origin 'rolled'. Stateless: nothing is saved. Use the roles in code; scale names are not stable.

brand.description: Brand colour. A hex string stays exactly as given; { hex, lock: 'hue' } keeps it too, and the generator keeps only its hue when the owner rolls again. Omit to roll one.

neutral.description: Neutral (greys for surfaces, text, borders), same form as brand. Omit to roll one from the grey colours in the pool (freely, with a hint of the brand's hue, when it has none).

extras.description: 0-5 extra colours for charts, tags and illustrations, same form as brand, optionally with a scale `name` (lowercase letters and '-'). Without a name it is suggested from the nearest Tailwind colour ('teal'). Extras get a scale, no role.

primary.description: 'vivid' (default): primary keeps the brand's hue, darkened just enough for white text at 4.5:1. 'hold': primary is the brand colour as is; the text on it adapts.

seed.description: Seed for the colours that are rolled. Pass the returned seed with the same pool to ask for the same roll again.

references.description: Roll missing colours from these references' palettes only (slugs from search_screens or recommend). Takes precedence over `project`.

project.description: Roll missing colours from the palettes of the references carrying this owner tag, e.g. 'harbor'. Without `references` and `project`, all approved references form the pool.

get_brand_kit.description: One of the owner's approved Brand Kits, by `slug` or as the approved kit of a `project`, always complete and as saved, nothing recomputed: 11 shadcn roles (hex, oklch(), derivation, WCAG 2 contrast to their counterpart), the scales (`anchorStep` holding the source colour, 11 steps 50-950 as hex), the stored contrast warnings, the source colours with their origin (a reference by slug and title for get_screen; `deleted: true` when the owner deleted it), the owner's `notes` and brand-specific Markdown `designBriefing` verbatim and `css`, the kit's CSS export (:root, a .dark block with dark roles read from the stored scales under the same names, and Tailwind v4 @theme inline). Use the roles in code; scale names are not stable.

slug.description: Kit slug from list_brand_kits. Takes precedence over `project`.

project.description: The owner tag of a project, e.g. 'harbor': returns the kit approved for it.

get_collection.description: Fetch one of the owner's collections by slug: description, project tag and its references in the owner's order.

get_design_system.description: The DESIGN.md for one reference: fonts, palette, CSS variables, type ramp and scales as stored, each value with its provenance; missing sections were not measured. Only with `live: true` it also reads the source page now, through the URL guard, and appends what that shows.

slug.description: Screen slug, e.g. 'linear-app'. Use search_screens or find_similar first to discover slugs.

live.description: Default false: stored values only, no network. true: also read the reference's source page now (through the URL guard; pattern-matched, not stored) and append it.

get_filters.description: Every value the filters accept: styles, industries, macrostructures, modes, vibes, colors, page types, component types. Zero input. Call it when unsure - an out-of-vocabulary value errors.

get_reference_jsx.description: The full JSX source of one of the owner's code templates, including the header stamp naming its macrostructure / theme / states. None are maintained yet; the call says so.

get_screen.description: Fetch the full record for one screen by slug - every viewport variant, palette, fonts, tech stack, designer credit, and `provenance`: where each design value comes from.

get_site_pages.description: A website's pages in the library as an ordered flow (landing → pricing → features → ...), grouped by host, with titles, northstars and thumbnails - how a real product sequences its pages. No arguments returns the directory of websites with more than one page. Accepts any page's slug.

siteSlug.description: Site slug (e.g. 'linear-app') or any screen slug from that site. Omit to list flow-capable sites instead.

limit.description: Directory mode only: max sites to list.

maxTokens.description: Approximate token ceiling for this response. Trims lower-ranked results and thumbnails; the top result and all URLs survive.

list_brand_kits.description: Lists the owner's approved Brand Kits: per kit name, slug, project (an owner tag, or null), the brand colour and `primary`, the hex of the primary role. Drafts and archived kits are never listed. get_brand_kit(slug) for roles, scales, CSS, the owner's notes and the Markdown design briefing.

project.description: Only the kit approved for this project (an owner tag such as 'harbor'); a project has at most one.

list_collections.description: List the owner's collections: references bundled around a theme or project, with description, project tag and count. Use this for thematic browsing, then get_collection or search_screens({collection}).

recommend.description: Start here for a brief. Returns the owner's own references that fit it, best first (favourites and matches in the owner's notes rank higher): per hit the owner's notes verbatim in `taste` (take, avoid, focus), the page structure, palette and fonts. `collection` and `project` are hard filters, like the others; with fewer than 3 hits a `gap` message says so instead of loosening them. No LLM call.

brief.description: The user's design brief in plain English. E.g. 'calm meditation app', 'dark dev-tool that helps teams ship faster'.

collection.description: Hard filter: only references in this collection (slug from list_collections).

project.description: Hard filter: only references carrying this owner tag, e.g. a project such as 'sample-project'.

macrostructure.description: Optional hard filter: only references with this macrostructure.

device.description: 'mobile' restricts to sites with a 375px capture pair or a mobile app screen and inlines the mobile thumbnail. Default: desktop.

search_screens.description: Search the archive of real website screenshots. Returns screens with palette, fonts, components and image URLs.

query.description: Natural-language description of what you're looking for. e.g. 'minimalist editorial agency portfolio'

pageType.description: Filter to a page kind: 'landing' (default homepages), 'pricing', 'features', 'auth', 'about', 'blog', 'changelog', 'docs', 'other'

paperBand.description: Surface lightness, measured from the capture: 'dark' (<30% L), 'mid' (30-85%), 'light' (>85%). More reliable than `mode`, which is tagged and disagrees with the measurement on ~15% of rows.

displayClass.description: Construction of the display face: 'grotesk-sans', 'geometric-sans', 'roman-serif', 'mono', 'display-condensed-bold', etc.
